description: An introduction to biological science, emphasizing cellular and physiological processes. Topics include principles of genetics, cell biology, plant physiology and animal physiology.
supplementalNotes:
• Not open to students with credit in any of BIOL 150, BIOL 184, BIOL 186, BIOL 190A, BIOL 190B.
  • BIOL 150A and BIOL 150B may be taken in any order. BIOL 150B cannot be taken concurrently with any of BIOL 184, BIOL 186. Major and Honours students, see Notes on Course Requirements.
title: Modern Biology
